title: Cipher and Portrait
author: Coral Winterbourne
blurb: Isandro Crane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
